LOOK & LEARN · CARD 06 OF 15 · AGES 2–5

Train Flashcard for Kids

A train is the loudest toy in the box and the longest thing on any track — engine first, carriages trailing behind. Card 06’s purple engine is already puffing, and the move is listening for the chuff.

Say it together

“Pretend the train is moving and say choo-choo.”

The card’s own move: Move & Listen.

Try it now

Choo-choo around the table in a line, one hand on the shoulder in front. Whisper the chuff, then roar it — a train has two volumes and your child owns both.
